name: XCC_BCE_BUSINESS_UNITS_
description: This is the audit table for XCC_BCE_BUSINESS_UNITS which holds the enablement information for Budgetary Control and Encumbrance Accounting for a business unit and ledger. Similar to the ledgers, a row will exist in this table for a Business Unit only after an end-user would have gone through the Enablement pages for this Business Unit. If a business unit does not have any corresponding row in this table, it will be considered not enabled.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Represents the ledger primary key.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Corresponds to the business unit identifier.

columns.name: LOCKED_FLAG
columns.description: Budgetary Control and Encumbrance Accounting Enablement Locked indicator. It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: BC_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Budgetary Control Enablement indicator. It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: EA_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Encumbrance Accounting Enablement indicator. It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: BC_LIQUIDATION_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the Budgetary Control liquidation date option such as Current Transaction Date.

columns.name: EA_LIQUIDATION_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the Encumbrance Accounting liquidation date option such as Current Transaction Date.

columns.name: BC_REVERSAL_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the Budgetary Control reversal date option such as Current Transaction Date.

columns.name: EA_REVERSAL_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the Encumbrance Accounting reversal date option such as Current Transaction Date.

columns.name: BC_REINSTATE_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Code to identify the budgetary control reinstate date option. Possible values include Current Transaction Date, Prior Related Transaction Date, or System Date.

columns.name: EA_REINSTATE_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Code to identify the encumbrance accounting reinstate date option. Possible values include Current Transaction Date, Prior Related Transaction Date, or System Date.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
